item.title: Meet Sofia Trazona, SexBomb Izzy Aragon's firstborn
item.description: SexBomb Girls member Izzy Trazona-Aragon and her eldest child, Andrei Trazona, have become a topic of discussion as Andrei came out of the closet to reveal her passion for drag queen and her drag alter ego, Sofia. While Andrei's transformation was met with support from the LGBTQ community and his fans, her mom Izzy's concerned reaction garnered attention online. In a lengthy Instagram post from September 11, Izzy aired her sentiments on being a mother to Drei and her worries for his well-being.
